notes.title: FotoMuseo 3D arrives to Stumble Guys!!
notes.content:
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/37403819/da924b229e4bb6d14f9e936ff51c1f6ad5190083.jpg

FotoMuseo 3D arrives to Stumble Guys developed by JonatanFoto (Russell) known as the Stumbler "FotoMuseo 3D" in the game's competitions.

A level developed with a challenging main route for users who already have a good base of experience in the game, where even the walls will make it difficult to overcome the game's obstacles.

In addition to 2.5 alternative routes that will allow us to skip much; or all; of the main route.

Will you try to challenge the level in Stumble Guys?
Enter the code: 0624-0813-7902 in the level search inside of the Stumble Guys WORKSHOP and challenge the routes to be the first to enter FotoMuseo 3D to see the Photos it has to offer.

notes.title: v4.0 UPDATE for FotoMuseo 3D
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=epAtTktPH-4;full][/previewyoutube]
Finally, the NEW Contentsfor FotoMuseo 3D are released.  with the UPDATE of the Version 4.0 of the game.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1267960/

Hard work that have been  rewarded my patience and tenacity in many moments. Here the COMPLETE CHANGELOG of changes for this v4.0 UPDATE:

EXPO 1 - 365 NOSTALGIC ITEMS
Own Achievement System implemented to see the achievements that we achieved during the gameplay and that we will achieve in Steam.Take the Flashlight and the Glasses ProxVisor from being optional they become mandatory to advance the adventure.Added Icon from HUD that tells us when we are crouching.Added Message from HUD to tell us "Wait" when a dialogue is playing and we try to perform some action.
Added the Dialogues of our character for the entire Expo 1. 
Added the option to choose between 4 Wishes to the Dragon Rhexon, during the level Secret of the Dragon Sky.Added 4 pedestals to choose our wish before asking the Dragon.The new Secret Maps unlockable after making our wish include:Level: "Grateful Maze."Level:  "Gravity Tool."Level: "Reflections and Farewells."Level: "Koddy Rider"Modified the route of the level "Dragon Sky": Now to access the upper part we must use a cloud flying type Kinton, instead of going up on foot as we did before. Rhexon appears and disappears now with a Lightning+Thunder before and after making our wish. Added the obligation to do the Leap of Faith as in the Assassins Creed from the platform indicated by the  Eagle summoned by Rhexon. If we make the jumpfrom any other place in Heaven, the Desire chosen will not be fulfilled. When we make a wish to the Dragon, access to the chosen secret map will be unlocked.Something will change or be unlocked in the following levels giving us access to the Secret Level selected in the Wish.For example , access to the Secret Level of Koddy Ridder, we will do it from the secret area of Koddy inside FotoMuseo. But we will only be able to access it once we make the wish.If we dieat some level for whatever reason, the Wishrequested to Rhexonand that would unlock some of the secret maps will be cancelled as well.Added a Koddy Interactive and drivable.Interactive water in one of the taps in the bathroom of PhotoMuseo.Added SHADER of dynamic clouds for the sky.Added movement to all VEGETATION (trees, bushes, plants...)  decorative of the game. Both at the level of TERRAIN/SKYBOX and at the level of independent 3D models .Corrected bug in SHADER of shadows that did not reflect the shadow of the leaves of the trees. Now they are seen correctly.Once the previous bug has been corrected, it has also been possible to animate the shadowshowing how the leaves move through the air in the shadow as well.Created Camera System that allows the game to momentarily deactivate the First Person camera of our character to show us areas of interest  or important events in the game.Created Rudimentary Reflex System of Mirrors through cameras.Inserted in some of the levels of Expo 1.Created rudimentary Inventory System. If we have an object that requires both hands, we will not be able to interact with the environment until we release it or fulfill its objective.Created Rudimentary Code System. Now we can change the Language during the game, as well as directly access the different Levels/Maps.Bug Corrections and Optimization of various levels. EXPO 2 -365 "MAIA - BOUDOIR PORTRAIT"Replaced from the Graphic materialexposed in the 3D Modelof the building that I modeled of the ATPD: "Association of Dental Prosthetic Technicians of the Basque Country", for the photos of the new Ambassador from Expo 2, MaIA for the Boudoir Portrait Project.Modeled a hybrid train unit based on those of Metro Bilbao and Euskotren. Inserted in the Start level of Expo 2. As an option to go to PhotoMuseo.Modified the route of the original Train type Ave , so that do not collide with the hybrid unitat the Station.Prepared a LEGO Building System to add models 3D of Lego created in Leocad. Prepared system to introduce 3D models your own created with the Townscaper.That's nothing! I am tremendously proud of all the workcarried out in 1 and a half / 2 years of work. I invite you to visit FotoMuseo 3D during its 4th Anniversary 

Will you dare to cross the portal and discover the secrets of FotoMuseo 3D?

notes.title: 1st Anniversary - Premiere of Version 3.0 of FotoMuseo 3D
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=ebWOE1Qz8tk;full][/previewyoutube]

To celebrate the 1st Anniversary of FotoMuseo 3D, a major in-game content update has been prepared. In addition to a new presentation:

[previewyoutube=pfcz7bavLp4;full][/previewyoutube]

The content added in this Version 3.0 of the game contains the following:

Creation of a totally new zone in the Language Selection Level.
Personalized "thank you" screen for people who support the game.
New Achievements.
New Zone with new building on the Tutorials level. Now we must get the Proxvisor Glasses in this house before heading to the Earthgate.
New room inside the Ship corresponding to the COMMAND BRIDGE to UNLOCK access to the HANGARS.
Optimized the Tutorial Level and bug fixes.
Enlargement of the area prior to the FotoMuseo with the secret game of painting a canvas and accessing its hidden area.
The Holograms of this previous area have been improved and mechanical models have been added simulating the movement of the animals.
New secret areas within FotoMuseo.
Photo room security cameras now focus and track the player.
We have access to the cameras from the Main Hall of the FotoMuseo (where we buy the tickets).
Correction of errors in the last levels of EXPO 1.
Added 3 LEVELS of EXPO 2 in ALPHA phase.
Map 1 of EXPO 2 will be a small open world. For now without buildings that will be created little by little.
Map 2 of EXPO 2 will be a cave map where a great secret is hidden in a box that will soon reveal its nature.
Map 3 of EXPO 2 will be the arrival by Train through a very special Earthgate.
These 3 maps from EXPO 2 are a PRELIMINARY and PROVISIONAL version of what they will be at the end. The work is still in progress so it will undergo many changes and content improvements over time.


And broadly speaking, these are all the additions of version 3.0 of FotoMuseo 3D.

Will you dare to cross the Earthgate to discover all the secrets of FotoMuseo 3D?

notes.title: FotoMuseo 3D continues growing in content!!
notes.content:
As I had been promising since FotoMuseo 3D saw the light in May of this fateful 2020, I continue working on adding new content and improvements to existing ones in FotoMuseo. And, considering it's my first big official indie game in 3D (since I did the LEFT 4 SGC campaign for LEFT 4 DEAD 2), I am very satisfied with the result.

Although if I have learned something with this tour, it is that what satisfies you today, tomorrow will seem little or bad ... so it will evolve to something better. Everything is in that I go step by step without giving up.

I would love to have some Feedback from the  community, as any constructive criticism, ideas or comments would be welcome to accelerate the process of continuous improvement that the game has on my part. But hey, someday it will come. And if it does not arrive and the game is detailed to a small group of players who gave it a chance, at least I will be satisfied with the path traveled and the one that I want to continue traveling.

As I already said, this news is in line with a major content update on the game's internal forum. Some of the many improvements that have been developed have been published on my Youtube channel under the title of DEVELOPER DIARY.

The first one was to show the functional improvement of the Teleportation System. And, thanks to this improvement, it's easier to create SEVERAL destinations for the same teleportation:
[previewyoutube=er3lls_EHp0;full][/previewyoutube]

The second DEV DIARY was to improve the Activation System of the [strike]Stargate[/strike] AHEM!! From EarthGate and its activation:
[previewyoutube=q41KVC06vwo;full][/previewyoutube]

The third is one of the most complex for me. Improve the exteriors by creating my own vegetation system for the grass, taking advantage of the one that already existed in the graphic engine:
[previewyoutube=1wzHeNKPK6E;full][/previewyoutube]

The forth is perhaps the one that people who are not dedicated to exploring will see the least. Since it is part of a secret UNLOCKABLE content in LEVEL 2. The 3D radar that tells us where a pedestal is located that will take us to a hidden area of the sky (heaven) ... And with "heaven", Dragon Ball fans will know what I mean:
[previewyoutube=SxE58in1dck;full][/previewyoutube]

The fifth is part of the third. It's the improvement of the Vegetation System but now to give more life to the trees with movement in their leaves and their branches:
[previewyoutube=EF2vGlAjt6s;full][/previewyoutube]

Although there is much more content developed for this great update such as:

    Improvement of the Dialogue System to be able to create subtitled conversations or explanations.
    Improved Language System to add new languages ​​in the future if necessary.
    Now we activate the EarthGate in the same garden, instead of doing it remotely from the spaceship.
    Reserved a new location (second house) in the first level of the tutorials for the near future.
    Improved the object management system in the 2D hands with which we interact.
    Added the fire effect through a Sprite system.
    Added texture movement effect using scripts.
    Creation of a new secret area hidden and unlockable under a small puzzle in LEVEL 3 of the game.
    ONE new ship model was developed, and TWO new ones were added to decorate the port.
    Restructured the Main FotoMuseo Zone to add access to rooms 201 to 20X for the future EXPO.
    Improved animations and interactions with the FotoMuseo Receptionist to whom we exchange the ticket to Expo 365 Nostalgic Items.
    Created an interactive Camera System in the Main Area of ​​the FotoMuseo with a small unlockable secret.
    Improved the diving system of the aquatic area of ​​Room 102.
    Added the 3D model of the security camera for all the rooms from where we will record the images of the Security System of the Main Zone
    Improved the unlockable Secret Access System in one of the Rooms. I won't tell you which one. You will have to find it for yourself. ;-)
    Created a little nod to creator Eric Matyas in Room 103, unlockable with a little secret.
    Added a surprise in the last of the expo rooms.
    Optimized the rain system to reduce the graphic memory required for rendering in the player's camera.
    Optimized the flying transport system in the first and last levels of the game. This platform is supposed to move materials from the port to the FotoMuseo in a comfortable way.
    Internal improvements in the management of some textures.
    Created a prologue to DEDICATE the 3D FotoMuseo to very special people and ...
    ... of course to you for getting here.


There have been many more improvements, but I invite you to discover them step by step ...

I will continue working on FotoMuseo 3D. Adding more content, improving the existing one and correcting errors will be where they appear.

Finally, I want to share 2 more videos as a mere curiosity to this great content update:
[previewyoutube=KStrT_Vf6Es;full][/previewyoutube]

And of course the Teaser 2.0 published on Steam maintaining the structure of the first one I did, but with some of the improvements and additions of content of this new version:
[previewyoutube=1_WS0GPL180;full][/previewyoutube]
